statement: Pinned hid-steam and SDL Triton sources now describe 0x42, 0x45 and SDL-only 0x47 byte layouts; steam-c6-input-42, steam-c6-input-45, steam-c6-input-47, steam-c6-input-buttons and steam-c6-input-scaling with steam-c6-* synthetic input fixtures provide a source-only reference. Physical wired HID captures, descriptor verification, firmware-dependent variants, real report timing, neutral baselines, calibration and end-to-end consumer results remain unknown.

applicability.scope: Residual physical/host gap after C6 source-backed field map and synthetic examples. No physical packets captured or hardware calibration validated; see C6 field map section of docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md.
